report.tagline: India's biggest online travel agency, where people book flights, hotels, holidays, trains and buses in one app.
report.simpleSummary: MakeMyTrip is the app many Indians open first when they plan a trip. You can book a flight to Goa, a hotel in Jaipur, a train ticket or a bus seat, all in one place. MakeMyTrip does not run planes or hotels. It sells their seats and rooms and earns a small cut or fee on each booking. It also owns Goibibo and redBus, so it covers almost every way Indians travel.

overview.whatItDoes: MakeMyTrip is an online travel agency, or OTA: a site that sells other companies' flights, hotel rooms, holiday packages, bus and train tickets and cabs. It shows prices side by side, takes payment, and helps when plans change. It runs three brands: MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and redBus.
howItWorks: A traveller searches a route or city, and MakeMyTrip pulls live prices and seats from airlines, hotels and bus operators.
The traveller picks an option, adds extras like insurance or seat selection, and pays in the app using UPI, cards or EMI.
MakeMyTrip passes the booking to the airline or hotel and keeps a commission or service fee.
Members earn MMT Black loyalty rewards and see member-only prices that bring them back.
After booking, the app handles web check-in, cancellations, refunds and support, including the Myra AI assistant.
overview.valueProposition: One trusted app to compare and book every part of an Indian trip, with deals, easy payment and help when a flight is cancelled.

coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Flights are the most searched product and the entry point for most customers.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Over 100,000 stays across 2,050+ Indian cities with reviews and photos.
coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Hotels pay a much higher commission than flights, so they drive most profit.

coreFeatures.whyItMatters: Keeps frequent travellers from switching to cheaper sites.

coreFeatures.whatItDoes: Chat assistant that answers questions, suggests trips and handles changes, with 80,000+ conversations a day.

businessModel.summary: MakeMyTrip makes money by taking a cut or fee on each booking, plus extras and ads. It keeps only about 10% of the value of what it sells as revenue, and about 1.8% as operating profit.

revenueStreams.detail: Commissions from airlines and convenience fees from customers, roughly 3% to 6% of fare. Biggest volume, thin margin.
Commissions of roughly 12% to 20% from hotels, plus markup on holiday packages. Highest margin.
Commission from bus operators on each seat sold, in India and abroad.
Ads from hotels and brands, insurance, forex, cabs, trains and corporate travel fees.

businessModel.pricing: Free to search. Customers pay the fare or room rate plus a convenience fee on many bookings (often ₹100 to ₹400 on flights). Paid add-ons like Zero Cancellation. MMT Black membership tiers.
costDrivers: Marketing and discounts, including bank offers and coupons
Customer support for cancellations and refunds
Performance marketing on Google and social media
businessModel.unitEconomics: Rough example, estimated. On a ₹6,000 domestic flight, MakeMyTrip might earn about ₹250 to ₹350 from airline commission and convenience fee, then spend ₹100 or more on payment fees, discounts and support, keeping very little. On a ₹10,000 hotel stay it might keep ₹1,200 to ₹1,800 as commission, which is where the real money is. So flights bring customers in cheaply and often, and hotels and packages pay the bills. Across everything, MakeMyTrip turned $10.4 billion of bookings into about $189 million of adjusted operating profit in FY26, about ₹1.80 of profit on every ₹100 booked.

howTheyGetUsers: Brand ads, especially around festivals and summer holidays
Bank card and UPI offers that pull price-sensitive users
Google search and app store ads
Owning Goibibo and redBus, which bring different user groups
whatBringsUsersBack: MMT Black loyalty rewards and member prices
Saved traveller details and payment methods make the next booking fast
Trip reminders, fare alerts and festival sale notifications
Trust built by past refunds and support help
growth.moat: MakeMyTrip has the largest supply of Indian hotels and homestays signed up, plus scale in flights and buses through redBus. More travellers attract more hotels, and more hotels attract more travellers, which is a network effect. It has also built 25 years of brand trust. Rivals can match flight prices, but matching hotel supply in 2,000+ cities is hard.

strengths: Clear market leader in Indian online travel, with three brands: MakeMyTrip, Goibibo and redBus
Deep hotel and homestay supply in small cities
Profitable, with strong cash flow ($182.5 million operating cash flow in FY26)
Early use of AI in support and trip planning through Myra
weaknesses: Flights earn very thin margins and are easy for customers to buy directly
Recurring complaints about refunds and support
Heavy reliance on India, so local airline problems hit results
risks: Airline troubles, like IndiGo's large cancellation waves, push refund load and anger onto MakeMyTrip
West Asia conflict and a weak rupee cut international travel, as seen in FY26 Q4
Google Travel and AI assistants could let users skip OTAs
Consumer protection rules on dark patterns and drip pricing in India
userComplaints: Refunds for cancelled flights taking weeks, or being partly lost to fees
Hard to reach a human on support
Convenience fees and add-ons that appear late in checkout
Hotels that do not match photos or cancel at the last minute
Prices that seem to rise after repeated searches

improvementIdeas.idea: Live refund tracker with a promised date and auto-compensation if late
improvementIdeas.problem: The top complaint is slow, unclear refunds after airline cancellations.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Fewer support calls and less churn after a bad trip.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Median refund days and refund-related tickets per 1,000 bookings

improvementIdeas.idea: Show the full price with all fees on the search results page
improvementIdeas.problem: Fees appearing at checkout feel like a trick and push users to EaseMyTrip.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Higher trust and possibly higher checkout conversion.

improvementIdeas.idea: Myra handles full rebooking when a flight is cancelled
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Faster help and lower support cost per booking.
improvementIdeas.metricToTrack: Share of disruption cases solved without a human

improvementIdeas.idea: Verified photo badge for hotels refreshed every year
improvementIdeas.problem: Guests complain hotels look worse than online.
improvementIdeas.expectedImpact: Fewer complaints and higher repeat hotel bookings.

improvementIdeas.idea: One-tap hotel suggestion right after a flight booking
improvementIdeas.problem: Many flight bookers book their hotel elsewhere.

pmLessons: Low-margin products can be the front door. Flights bring users often, and hotels make the money.
Trust is won or lost after the booking. Refunds and support during a cancellation matter more than the booking screen.
Owning several brands lets you serve different users: Goibibo for deal seekers, redBus for bus travellers.
Hidden fees save a few rupees today but cost loyalty and invite regulators.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you increase hotel bookings among people who only book flights on MakeMyTrip?
interviewQuestions.hint: Segment flight bookers by trip type, find why they book hotels elsewhere, propose timing and bundle ideas, track attach rate and guardrail on margin.

interviewQuestions.question: IndiGo cancels hundreds of flights in a week. What should MakeMyTrip's product do?
interviewQuestions.hint: Prioritise stranded users, automate rebooking and refunds, communicate proactively, protect support capacity. Measure resolution time and NPS.

interviewQuestions.question: Should MakeMyTrip remove convenience fees like EaseMyTrip?
interviewQuestions.hint: Estimate revenue lost per booking against conversion gain and trust. Suggest testing in one segment first.

interviewQuestions.question: What is the north star metric for MakeMyTrip, and why not gross bookings?
interviewQuestions.hint: Explain that gross bookings counts cancelled and refunded trips; pick completed trips or repeat bookers and break it into drivers.

interviewQuestions.question: How would you use AI like Myra without hurting customer trust?
interviewQuestions.hint: Pick high-volume simple tasks first, always offer a human handoff, measure resolution rate and CSAT, and watch for wrong answers.

glossary.meaning: Online travel agency: a website or app that sells other companies' flights, hotels and tickets.
The total money customers spend on trips booked through the platform, before the platform takes its cut.
Profit from the main business after normal costs, leaving out one-off and non-cash items.
An extra charge added by the booking site on top of the ticket price.
The share of customers who buy an extra product along with the main one.
When a service gets more useful for everyone as more people and sellers join it.
The share of people who complete a purchase after starting a search.
Net Promoter Score: a survey score showing how likely customers are to recommend the product.
The one metric a team treats as the best sign that customers are getting value.
When customers stop using a product.
A metric that must not get worse while the team pushes the main metric.

Commission ranges for flights (3% to 6%) and hotels (12% to 20%) are typical industry ranges, not MakeMyTrip disclosures.
